payload.body:
**Ticket ID:** `MP-ART-ANALYSIS-009`  
**Priority:** P1  

---


# Add Hermes configuration keys for analysis and align analysis and KG dev-docs with PRD scoring

**Group:** Article Analysis Agent (`article-analysis-agent`)

## Summary

Adds global Hermes env and configuration keys for article analysis: model and token limits, default `maxBatchSize`, POST chunk size, max content length and summary toggle, optional debounce guards (minimum unanalyzed count, minimum minutes since last successful analysis), extraction caps, scoring weights for canonical breakdown keys, `ARTICLE_ANALYSIS_SCORE_BREAKDOWN_VERSION`, and selection limits (`ARTICLE_ANALYSIS_MAX_SELECTED_PER_TICKER_PER_DAY`, minimum score threshold, optional mix caps). Updates dev-docs so analysis and knowledge graph pages describe canonical v1 breakdown keys and scheduling guidance relative to data-collection.

## Scope

- In scope: Add variables via `@mediapulse/env` (and `env.example` with env-to-t3 annotations), rebuild env package per skill. Wire agent reads to these keys with production defaults. Document debouncing as additive to dashboard schedules: agent exits success on no-op when guards trip. Document pipeline order query-analysis, data-collection, article-analysis, content generation and delivery, with cadence examples and stagger guidance. Replace legacy scoring tables in dev-docs with PRD canonical keys and `_version` when MP-ART-ANALYSIS-006 did not already update them.
- Out of scope: Per-ticker Hermes overrides (PRD non-goal). New scheduler product.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] All new env vars are documented in the correct `env.example` with comments and t3 annotations.
- [x] Agent reads model, batch, chunk, cap, weight, version, selection, and debounce settings from typed env with safe defaults for development.
- [x] `ARTICLE_ANALYSIS_SCORE_BREAKDOWN_VERSION` matches `_version` embedded in POST bodies for a given deployment configuration.
- [x] Dev-docs for analysis agent, KG flow, and scheduling reflect PRD canonical keys, selection behavior, and recommended stagger between collection and analysis.
- [x] `pnpm code-quality` passes after env and doc updates.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-006
- Blocks: none

## Notes

Follow [.cursor/skills/env-variables/SKILL.md](.cursor/skills/env-variables/SKILL.md). Doc updates may ship in the same PR as MP-ART-ANALYSIS-006 if preferred, this ticket ensures env and operational docs are complete. Provider keys remain server-only without `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefix.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/article-analysis-agent-prd.md
